generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Contractors should have Civil contractor registration in KPWD / KUWSDB, etc., Those who does not have BWSSB registration can also participate in the tender provided they should get registered in the Board in case the tender is awarded before the issue of Work Order.

The Tenderer Should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of rupees not less than the less than the estimated cost under this contract i.e Rs.87.07 Lakhs
The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work. i.e Rs.43.54 Lakhs
The tender should have executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work usually 80% of the annual requirement i,e 300mm dia & above RCC NP3 pipeline work 525.92 m & above
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities usually 30% of the amount of contract i.e Rs. 26.12 Lakhs. As per the format of KTPP act.
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in e-procurement portal.
Other details can be seen in the tender documents.
